CSF root cannot accept downstream device with authorization-request-type serial/certificate with non-default management port.
On the Security Fabric > Automation page, the Duplicate Firewall Objects security rating does not work as expected, even it should be passed.
The AZURE type dynamic firewall address takes longer than normal to resolve itself, even with the correct filter value in the robot test bed.
The fsvrd listens on port 8013 and provides a certificate with set allowaccess fabric.
On the VPN > SSL-VPN Settings page, when renaming a selected Restrict Access Host object, the object is deselected.
Internet services cannot be used (IPv4 and IPv6) as destination in SSL VPN policies with dual stack enabled.
Remove SSL VPN from FGT 9xG.
Duplicate log entries are created for SSL VPN when the tunnel is up or down.
An unauthenticated user mismatch occurs with the user.
SAML login from a Windows FortiClient is blocked when sslvpn-webmode is disabled in the config system global command.
SSL VPN encounters a signal 11 interruption and does not work as expected due to a word-length heap memory issue.
Login fails for local remote TAC+ users with FortiToken when waiting for token response.
Unauthenticated login occurs when virtual-host-only is enabled in realm configuration.
SMB bookmarks become inaccessible through SSL-VPN web portal mode due to incorrect DNS server path definitions.

Blocked internal resource access occurs when FCT reestablishes a TLS tunnel using the same DHCP IP after a brief link downtime, due to improper handling of the previous tunnel's AP session and tun dev index.
Incorrect maximum values present in CLI schema files.
The SSL VPN OS checklist in FortiOS does not include minor versions of macOS 13 and 14, nor macOS Sequoia 15.0.
When FCT reestablishes a TLS tunnel quickly after a network disruption, SSL VPN attempts an IP association with the same IP, causing a duplication and no value assigned to the tun dev index.
Unexpected behavior caused by SSL VPN when multiple routes are configured with the same address.
Preconfig option issues occur when adding new FSW models.
FortiGate GUI shows multiple entries for the same FortiSwitch when exporting it to be used by several VDOMs.
When trying to start and stop the FortiSwitch LED blink using the Security Fabric, the GUI shows a Failed to send command error.
On the System > Firmware & Registration page, the FortiSwitch registration status changes from Not registered to Failed to fetch status when it is deauthorized and then authorized.
On the WiFi & Switch Controller > SSID page, NAC policies using a Wildcard MAC Address cannot be saved using the GUI.
observations.workaround: use the CLI to perform the operation.

observations.description: Firmware installation fails when upgrading FortiSwitch devices through FGT GUI.
When the name of the FortiSwitch does not match its serial number, it shows up as not registered on the System > Firmware & Registration and Security Fabric > Fabric Connectors pages.
When editing a dynamic port policy, saved changes are not shown in the GUI.
The NAC policy is not visible in the GUI due to switch-fortilink not set in the NAC policy.
FortiLink protocol redundancy issues caused by dynamic discovery in capwap protocol.
Random CPU spikes and for cu_acd process.
The managed switch incorrectly reverts to the default time zone after reboot due to improper handling of zero-minute GMT values in the configuration.
Command execution fails when running switch-controller get-conn-status or diagnose-connection commands.
Users cannot de-select all values from Allowed VLANs and related policies due to a GUI malfunction.
On the Firmware page, the Registration Status shows a Failed to fetch status error for an online FortiSwitch. The CLI shows that its registered.
The FortiSwitch port configuration GUI under FortiOS 7.6.0 no longer allows users to de-select all values for Allowed VLANs, Security Policy, or QOS Policy.
High CPU utilization occurs when flpold/flcfgd processes mishandle socket messages during WAD operations due to incomplete or corrupted data.
The dynamic VLAN is not visible in the GUI.
VLAN sub interface event logs for interface status changes are inaccurate.
Support "dr" mediatype for 100GBASE-DR transceivers.
ACME certificates cannot be renewed manually before their expiration date.
High CPU usage occurs when FortiGate is attacked by 4K PPS ARP requests.
On the NP7 platform, setting the interface configuration using set inbandwidth <x> or set outbandwidth <x> commands stops traffic flow.
observations.workaround: Change the NP7 default-qos-type setting from shaping to policing. This requires a restart of the device for the configuration to take effect: config system npu set default-qos-type policing end

observations.description: On FortiGate 1000D models, the SFP 1G port randomly experiences flapping during operation.
FortiGate encounters increasing Rx_CRC_Errors on SFP ports on the NP6 platform when an Ethernet frame contains carrier extension symbols to Cisco devices.
LED of MGMT and HA port do not go off after issuing "execute shutdown" on some models.
FortiGate experiences packet loss when using an internal hardware switch.
Egress shaping does not work on NP when applied on the WAN interface.

After upgrading FortiGate and not changing any configuration details, the output of s_duplex in get hardware nic port command displays Half instead of Full. This is purely a display issue and does not affect system operation.
FortiGate cannot communicate with ACME client and cannot generate certificate.

FortiGate 60F and 61F models may experience a memory usage issue during a FortiGuard update due to the ips-helper process. This can cause the FortiGate to go into conserve mode if there is not enough free memory.
Unexpected behavior in WAD occurs when handling null values.
FortiGate 100E/101E units may enter an unresponsive state (no GUI, SSH, or console access) due to a rare timing issue, requiring a system reboot to regain access.
FortiGate enters a loop cycle and generates a large number of LACP packets when FortiGate does not receive LACP packets from a peer device.
After a restarting FortiGate from the GUI, the auto-nego SFP port settings are not reflected in FortiGate.
In some instances when setting qos-type as shaping, kernel panic may result.
When a SIM card is ejected from a FortiGate using dual SIM cards, the log message does not indicate the slot number FortiOS is switching to.
When FortiGate experiences a memory usage issue and enters into conserve mode, the system file integrity check may not work as expected and cause the device to shutdown.
After configuring a virtual wire pair (VWP) setting, it is not present in FortiGate after a reboot.

When configuring an SNMP trusted host that matches the management Admin trusted host subnet, the GUI may give an incorrect warning that the current SNMP trusted host does not match. This is purely a GUI display issue and does not impact the actual SNMP traffic.
Error condition in WAD occurs when writing SHM data.
FortiGate experiences a CPU usage issue when dedicated-management-cpu is enabled.
Insufficient free memory on entry-level Fortigate devices with 2 GB RAM may cause unexpected behavior in the IPS engine.
The SNMP trap is not sent out when a virus is detected on the antivirus scanner.
FortiGate encounters increasing Rx_CRC_Errors on SFP ports on the NP6 platform when an Ethernet frame contains carrier extension symbols to Cisco devices.
VDOM limit increase occurs when increasing VDOM limit on mid-range FortiGates.
The SFP+ port LED does not illuminate and displays a speed 10Mbps even though the link status up and speed is set to 1000Mbps.
FortiGate encounters a memory usage issue on DNS proxy, resulting in FortiGate going into conserve mode.
FortiGate does not auto negotiate to Full duplex when connecting to FortiSwitch due to a duplication error.
On FortiGate, NP7 offloaded traffic does not use the updated MAC address from the ARP table to forward traffic using a GRE tunnel.
The DNS proxy does not forward the response after upgrading FortiGate.
When the configuration changes using the SSH, a backup failed alert is generated.
Privilege issues occur when using super_admin read-only profile.
No ICMP error messages are sent when oversized packets are received by IPv6 tunnels with fragmentation disabled.
Config revision files are incomplete during restores after firmware updates due to background save timeouts.
FortiGate 4800F model split ports do not work as expected causing issues with LACP and MRU on split ports.
On FortiGate, the snmp daemon does not work as expected resulting in the SNMP queries timing out.
FortiGate encounters an interruption in the kernel due to a NULL pointer issue.
Backing up a configuration using SFTP with the domain username does not work when characters @ and \ are in the username.
In some scenarios, when FortiGate as a DHCP client sends out DHCP-REQUEST packets, the SRC IP address is set in the IP header.
Security improvements caused by using immutable flag to control FOS firmware security instead of LSM read/write control.
On FortiGate, IP addresses cannot be assigned within a configured IP range due to a DHCP server issue.
On FortiGate, the console displays error messages when adding Pre and Post-login banners due to a rare error condition.
FortiGate reboots after a connected HA heartbeat cable is connected, or running the diag hardware deviceinfo nic ha command.
FortiGate cannot get updates from the public FortiGuard servers in FIPS-CC mode.
The traffic shaper does not take effect on the firewall policy when traffic is offloaded to NP7 due to a traffic management issue.
Duplicate SNMP traps are sent to ha-direct enabled trap servers when two ha-mgmt-intf are configured.
Error messages appear during bootup when FortiOS devices that support CGNAT lack a valid hyperscale license.
FortiOS processes packets on a non-active port of a redundant link.
The DNS server does not operate as expected with forward-only mode enabled.
Lack of speed options occurs when configuring network interfaces on FGT91G/121G devices, limiting available settings.
The "dsl" test appears in hardware tests for non-DSL models where it should not be enabled.
A FortiGuard update can cause the system to not operate as expected if the FortiGate is already in conserve mode. Users may need to reboot the FortiGate.
Unnecessary configuration saves occur when the daemon check command is triggered
FortiGate does not work as expected due to an interruption in the kernel.
On FortiGate 900 models, when the baudrate is configured, the changes are not applied and is set to 9600.
The ptp server does not work on the vlan interface.
IPsec tunnels become unreachable on FortiGates with np7lite hardware when "vpn-id-ipip" is configured due to missing support for VPN ID IP/IP offloading in NPU processing.
Error messages are printed when assigning a transparent vdom to a vdom link interface.
FortiGate returns a string with a % sign for the OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.12356.101.4.8.2.1.8 (fgLinkMonitorPacketLoss).
EXPIRE dates are not displayed properly when executing the get sys fortiguard-service status command due to a formatting issue.
Inaccurate traffic counters display for EMAC-VLAN interfaces when VLAN ID is set to 0 and traffic is offloaded to the NPU.
DNSproxy CPU is running high.
Port link down occurs when upgrading to v7.4.5 with 1G Switch connected.
FortiGate 100E series models sometimes get unresponsive.
An error is observed in the dnsproxy caused by the use of secondary dns-database zones.
An incorrect /8 connected route is advertised by FortiGate 80F-DSL when configured with a LANTIQ-based DSL modem.
FortiGate does not boot up after restoring a configuration file containing an invalid string format.
snmpwalk receives "No Session Data" response of fgFwPolLastUsed OID while the background traffic keeps running.
The source IP is not replaced as per the set fmg-source-ip after adding the device directly.
FortiGate 60F and 40F models become stuck after entering conserve mode and hbdev and console access is lost.
CPU usage issues observed during FortiGate upgrade from B2689 to B3419.
The DHCP relay uses the wrong interface to send DHCP offer packets to the client.

Upgrading directly from 7.2.4 or earlier versions to 7.2.9, or directly from 7.0.11 or earlier to 7.2.9 is not supported. Users must upgrade following the recommended upgrade path to avoid system hanging.
Write permission violation log observed in FortiGate in a rare case caused by the host check plugin used in FortiClient/browser side.
Link/Activity LEDs of MGMT and HA ports remain lit after executing 'exec shutdown' in FortiOS v7.4.2 and later.
FortiWiFi 61F models experience a memory usage issue caused by the WAD daemon.
IPv6 connections fail when iPhones access test sites via IPoE due to improper handling of NA messages using link-local addresses.
NP7 offloaded traffic continues to use old gateway's MAC address when receiving packets with TTL=1 after a gateway change.
Admin user gets logged out when entering an 'unset sdns-server-ip' command in FortiOS CLI during configuration through a tool with specific command timing and sequence.
Shared copper WAN1 and WAN2 ports remain down when the interface speed is set to 100full.
Configuration issues occur when setting Digital IO module on FGR.
An error condition in new CLI occurs during command processing due to invalid context.
RST packet is sent when ident-accept is enabled on vne interface.
Private data encryption key generation issues caused by manual entry of 32-digit hexadecimal keys.
A CPU usage issue in the Softirq space on 40/160 CPU cores causes packets to drop.
System unresponsive triggered by CPU profiling across all cores.
LACP/shared ports wan1 and wan2 are down after an upgrade or reboot due to hardware shared-port medium changes.

FortiGate cannot restore the configuration file in the following sequence. 1. private-data-encryption enabled with random key, and configuration is backed up. 2. private-data-encryption disabled. 3. private-data-encryption enabled again, with new random key. 4. Restore configuration file in step 1.
CRC errors occur on NP6 platform SFP port when connected to Cisco ISR 4431 with fiber transceiver.
WCCP failure occurs when enabling WCCP under interface.
DHCP request issues occur when using VRF in DHCP Relay.
After a reboot, FortiGate shows the wrong date if the date was set manually prior to the reboot.
Frequent kernel panics occur due to dynamic update of EMS IP/MAC addresses in multiple vdom, causing the device to freeze and require a reboot.

Hardware limitation on the NP7 platform causes the following QTM related issues: Incorrect checksum for fragments after QTM. The workaround is to not parse Layer4 after QTM. Packets longer than 6000 bytes cause QTM unresponsiveness. Refresh issue causes QTM unresponsiveness. The workaround is to use one refresh list. MTU is not honored after QTM, so packets are not fragmented.
FortiGate logs out when deleting the secondary IP configured on an interface in work space mode.
High memory consumption occurs when multiple SNMP child processes are created due to frequent queries, as they fail to terminate properly and accumulate in memory.
FEXT remains offline when FortiGate is upgraded from b3443 to b3446
System hang occurs when cp-accel-mode is set to advanced on 2G memory platforms.
Automatic firmware upgrade issues caused by default auto-firmware-upgrade value.
FortiGate does not boot up properly after an upgrade when it has a large number (500+) of VDOMs configured.
Password errors occur when private-data-encryption is enabled after upgrade.
Page fails to reload after successful FTM push authentication for remote LDAP users in firewall policies.
FortiGate experiences a gradual memory usage issue in the fnbamd process.
The Strict-SNI SSL Profile might block TCP connections if the SNI cannot be verified due to an active probe failure.
EST HTTP passwords are not encrypted in the config file during certificate enrollment with EST.
FortiGate encounters a CPU usage issue in the authd process after a firmware upgrade.
The reply-to option under config system alertmail is removed even for custom mail-servers with 2-factor authentication after an upgrade.
The TACACS+ connection times out, irrespective of the remoteauthtimeout setting, due to an issue with the ldapconntimeout setting, after upgrading to version 7.4.4.
FortiOS may reply to an FTM push message using a different egress interface instead of the original interface.
Admin access to GUI remains valid despite exceeding the two-factor-email-expiry timeout.
NTLM authentication does not work as expected after an upgrade.
CMPv2 IR does not work as expected due to server certification validation error conditions.
On the Dashboard > Firewall User Monitor page, the Search field does not display in the GUI when there are a large number (+1000) FSSO user logos.
An ACME certificate enrollment error is generated without detailed error message information.
The Active Firewall-Authentication for 2FA FAC RADIUS users using PAP method does not work as expected after upgrading to version 7.4.4.
On FortiGate, RADSEC sent incorrect accounting packets due to a hashing issue.
RADIUS message authenticator checking is not optional under TLS.
FortiToken activation-code emails fail to send when using the shortcut method due to missing recipient email addresses in the logs after an upgrade.
FortiGate initiates LDAPS sessions that do not respect the ssl-min-proto-version option set under the config system global command.

For FortiGate (versions 7.2.10 and 7.4.5 and later) and FortiNAC (versions 9.2.8 and 9.4.6 and prior) integration, when testing connectivity/user credentials against FortiNAC that acts as a RADIUS server, the FortiGate GUI and CLI returns an invalid secret for the server error. This error is expected when the FortiGate acts as the direct RADIUS client to the FortiNAC RADIUS server due to a change in how FortiGate handles RADIUS protocol in these versions. However, the end-to-end integration for the clients behind the FortiGate and FortiNAC is not impacted.
SCEP certificate auto-renewal fails to trigger when forticron experiences excessive pending DNS requests due to server unavailability.
FortiGate Captive Portal does not send the full Server Certificate Chain.

When RADIUS server has the require-message-authenticator setting disabled, The GUI RADIUS server dialogs Test connectivity and Test user credentials still check for the message-authenticator value and incorrectly fail the test with missing authenticator error message. config user radius edit <radius server> set require-message-authenticator disable next end This is only a GUI display issue and the end-to-end integration with RADIUS server should still work.
CPU usage issues observed during execution of lock functions.
The FortiGate-VM OCI may not detect an extra port attached.
The FortiGate-AWS HA secondary awsd debug result prints raw HTML content.
When FortiGate returns an ICMP TTL-EXCEEDED message, the geneve option field header is missing.
A FortiGate VM HA in Azure Cloud may intermittently go out of synchronization due to an issue in the daemon process.
FortiToken does not work as expected after moving a FortiGate-VM license to a new VM with the same serial number.
FortiGate VM Azure does not work as expected and enters into conserve mode in vWAN setup.
FGT_KVM console cannot be accessed using serial tools under a trial license when configured with multiple virtio interfaces and queues.
FortiGate VM performance drops when traffic passes through an inter-vdom link.
Dynamic firewall address list entries are deleted when AWS STS tokens expire prematurely.
FortiFlex license fails to install consistently during Day0 configuration when using Port2 for Internet access, as injection occurs before connectivity is established.
The VLAN interface is not reachable on a FortiGate VM running KVM with Intel 10G NIC (10Gb ethernet card).
The OCI SDN connector cannot call the API to the Oracle service when an IAM role is enabled.
Inadvertent traffic disruption observed on FortiGate-VM64 caused by a deadlock in the newcli process.
VLAN traffic fails to pass through E810-XXV NIC with SFP28 transceiver and 25G speed after enabling DPDK.
Security rules with port range can be pushed to the Azure VWAN SLB successfully, but the SLB doesn't allow the specified port range.
The command ""diag test app awsd 3"" generates no output when no AWS SDN connector is configured.
The FGVM console becomes unresponsive after a hard reboot in OpenStack environments running on Redhat Enterprise Linux 9.2 when using USB keyboards.
FortiOS becomes unresponsive when sending IPv6 traffic over MLX5 network adapters due to incorrect WQE handling.
The SIP ALG does not create the expected session for SIP OPTIONS traffic.
The Web Application Firewall marks http/s traffic as a malformed constraint.
A matched pattern in the HTTP body cannot be blocked with a waf profile for some content types.
When a webfilter time-based quota is configured, once quota is reached, long sessions are not terminated.
The webfilter and traffic logs show the incorrect realserver IP address due to a WAD process issue.
When enabling the log all search keywords in the web filter profile and VDOM mode is disabled, the Key Word column is not populated with data.
User input ID check doesn't exclude its current-configured ID.
URLs fail to match intended regex patterns when special characters are escaped with backslashes.
6GHz channels are allowed to configure for some EU countries.
WIDS data is not removed from the CLI.
Wi-Fi devices would encounter service delay when roaming over captive-portal SSID with MAC-address authentication.
Secondary AC wpad_ac memory usage increases during stress tests with simulators in HA setups.
Clients could not get IP address from bridge-mode captive-portal SSID when the external portal sever is configured on another FortiGate unit.
Cannot retrieve DHCP IP's from the assigned VLAN when connecting Bridge SSID with RADIUS-based MAC authentication.
On FortiGate 90G and 120G models, traffic is dropped due to the MAC address of the VAP interface being updated with the old MAC address when HA is enabled.

On the WiFi & Switch Controller > Managed FortiAPs page, when upgrading more than 30 managed FortiAPs at the same time using the Managed FortiAP page, the GUI may become slow and unresponsive when selecting the firmware.
RADIUS authentication in a WPA2-Enterprise SSID does not use ha-mgmt-interface when ha-direct is enabled.
GUI Local WiFi Radio Channel Utilization shows "N/A" while it is actually available and readable.
On FortiGate, the set max-clients feature does not work as expected and allows more clients to connect than the maximum value configured.
Change the region/SKU assignment of the following nine countries: BB, BZ, CO, DO, GD, GY, HN, FM, and PA to A (from K model) or N (G & Older model).
Duplicated WiFi event logs occur when acd-process-count is set for multi-core processing in FortiGate.
Users cannot make any changes to wtp-profile due to an issue with the REST API connection to the cmdbsvr.
An unknown source IP appears in client-authentication logs when laptops connect to wireless networks at specific sites.
Group name fails to display in station list after local authentication with 2FA for Enterprise+User-group SSID connections.
The VLAN ID is lost during roaming with WPA-PSK and Fast BSS Transition enabled, causing connectivity issues as the client loses its network segmentation.
DFS channels are allowed to configure on the wtp-profile of FAP-241K/243K in regions "A", "E", "I", "Y", "S", "V", "H", "D" and "N" (without Brazil).
FortiClient access to TCP-FWD with saml authentication does not redirect the loop if set ztna vip and saml SP use the same IP address.
An interruption occurs in the WAD when accessing ZTNA TCP-forwarding service through a proxy-policy with a SAML user group and h2-support is disabled on the firewall vip.
PPPoE encounters a performance issue after an upgrade.
SAML authentication failure occurs when using ZTNA with SAML authentication.
Long sessions without any authentications terminate after 5 hours.
SAML single-sign-on-url update issues occur when changing the user SAML configuration.
The image upgrade fails when performing a non-graceful update due to an ISIZE mismatch during verification.
Unexpected behavior observed in NPD when the threat feed object attempted to update manually in the HA pair.
For FG-480xF/FFW-480xF, using npu-group other than 0 with log2host around ~1M CPS could result in NP chip getting stuck.
FortiGate's with 4GB memory might enter conserve mode during the FortiGuard update when IPS or APP control is enabled.
observations.workaround: Disable the proxy-inline-ips option under config ips settings.

observations.description: Failed HTTP sessions occur when passing through nTurbo due to improper handling of fragmented packets.
FortiSwitch units are offline after FortiGate is upgraded from 7.4.6 or 7.6.0 to 7.6.1 or later when LLDP configuration is set to vdom/disable under the FortiLink interface.
observations.workaround: In LLDP configuration, enable lldp-reception and lldp-transmission under the FortiLink interface, or rebuild the FortiLink interface.

observations.description: Duplicated RADIUS packets are captured by the sniffer when performing firewall authentication with a RADIUS server.
Unexpected behavior observed in the newcli daemon due to inconsistencies in node registration between cmdbsvr and other daemons.
The image file transfer between FortiManager and FortiGate may not work as expected when transferred by the FGFM tunnel.
On FortiGate, not all registered endpoint EMS tags are displayed in the GUI.
FortiGate may not display the correct user information for some FortiClient instances.
On the Policy & Objects > Traffic Shaping page, when deleting or creating a shaper, the counters for the other shapers are cleared.
When searching for an IP address on the Firewall Policy page, the search/filter functionality does not return the expected results.

The By Sequence view in the Firewall policy list may incorrectly show a duplicate implicit deny policy in the middle of the list. This is purely a GUI display issue and does not impact policy operation. The Interface Pair View and Sequence Grouping View do not have this issue.

Leaving the apn field empty in a GTP APN traffic shaping policy means that the policy will not match any traffic. Consequently, APN traffic shaping can only be applied to specific APNs. To configure GTP APN traffic shaping: config gtp apn-shaper edit <policy-id> set apn [<apn-name> <apngrp-name> ...] set rate-limit <limit> set action {drop | reject} set back-off-time <time> next end
SSL VPN user status does not display on the FortiManager GUI.
After a failover, ARP entries are removed from all slots when an ARP query of single slot does not respond.
When there is a heavy traffic load, there are no results displayed on any FortiView pages in the GUI.
On NP7 platforms, DSW packets are missing resulting in VOIP experiencing performance issues during peak times.
Feature Visibility options are visible in the GUI on a mgmt-vdom.
On FortiGate 7000F using FGSP and FGCP, when TCP traffic takes an asymmetric path, the TCP ACK and data packets might be dropped in NP7.
When doing a GUI-packet capture on FortiGate, the through-traffic packets are not captured.
After an HA failover, there is no IPsec route in the kernel.
observations.workaround: Bring down and bring up the tunnel.

observations.description: SLBC does not function as expected with IPsec over TCP enabled.
The Application Bandwidth widget on the Dashboard > Status page does not display some external applications bandwidth data.
When viewing entries in slide-out window of the Policy & Objects > Internet Service Database page, users cannot scroll down to the end if there are over 100000 entries.

High Node.js memory usage when building FortiManager in Report Runner fails. Occurs when FortiManager has a slow connection, is unreachable from the FortiGate (because FMG is behind NAT), or the IP is incorrect.
When HA members are not registered under the same FortiCare account, the HA cluster cannot obtain contract info of all members from FortiGuard servers.
vSN support added in 7.2.9, 7.4.6, and 7.6.1. FG-100F/101F do not yet support vSN and logical-sn.
System > HA: There is no upgrade button on secondary GUI page when HA in local-only or secondary-only MVC upgrade mode.
observations.workaround: upgrade the secondary via the command line.

observations.description: Intermittent traffic interruption and error messages 'NPD-0 :DEL PRP FAIL! 0xffffffff' and 'NPD-0 :PRP ADD FAIL! 0xffffffff nat_type=00000044 block_sz=128 port_base=11000' observed on the console after automation test.
Using fixed-allocation IP Pools may cause NP7 NSS/PRP modules to become stuck, potentially disrupting traffic. Other PBA IP pools do not have this issue.

After upgrade, event log shows logdesc="IPSA driver update failed" msg="Fail to update IPSA driver status!". This issue only affects physical FortiGate models with the following IPS engine versions: IPS Engine version: 7.550 - 7.567 IPS Engine version: 7.1019 - 7.1039 To determine the IPS Engine versions, use the command: get sys fortiguard-service status | grep 'IPS/FlowAV Engine'
observations.workaround: Power off the FortiGate. Wait 30 seconds, and then power on the FortiGate. Note: Reboot using the CLI is not an effective workaround and requires additional steps. After executing exec shutdown, unplug the power to the FortiGate. Wait one minute, and the power on the FortiGate.

observations.description: VPN tunnels exhibit instability following an upgrade, with processes stuck during NP7 debugging due to improper prioritization of certain packets.
IPsec VPN traffic is dropped after upgrading to version 7.4.3.
DH group mismatches with INVALID_KE when peer proposes a DH group in its IKE_SA_INIT which is not in the expected order
On FortiOS, the Log & Report > Forward Traffic page does not completely load the entire log when the log exceeds 200MB.
After an upgrade on a 2GB FortiGate device, the firewall policy does not switch from Proxy-based to Flow-based in the Inspection mode field.
The firewall policy works with proxy-based inspection mode on FortiGate models with 2GB RAM after an upgrade.
observations.workaround: After an upgrade, reboot the FortiGate.

observations.description: The router API does not include all ECMP routes for SD-WAN included in the get router info routing-table command.
Physical and logical topology is slow to load when there are a lot of managed FortiAP devices (over 50). This issue does not impact FortiAP management and operation.
FortiGate experiences a CPU usage issue in the Node.js daemon when there multiple administrator sessions running simultaneously.
In an HA configuration, when the primary FortiGate unit fails over to a downstream unit, the previous primary unit displays as being permanently disconnected.
The Security Rating topology and results does not display non-FortiGate devices.
An interface in FortiLink is flapping with an MCLAG FortiSwitch using DAC on an OPSFPP-T-05-PAB transceiver.
Connection issue between SOC4 platform and third-party switches because SOC4 doesn't support certain carrier extension signals.
Traffic flow speed is reduced or interrupted when the traffic shaper is enabled.
After shutting down a SOC4 FortiGate (FGT-40F/FGT-61F/FGT-81F/FGT-100F) using the "execute shutdown" command, the system automatically boots up again.
Some FortiGate models experience unexpected interface down time when using DAC cables after upgrade due to improper Signal-OK loss detection.
If the DHCP offer contains padding when DHCP relay is used, the DHCP relay deletes the padding before relaying the packet.
Upgrading the firmware for a large number (100+) of FortiSwitch or FortiAP devices at the same time may cause performance issues with the GUI and some devices may not upgrade.
observations.workaround: pace out the upgrade schedule and upgrade devices in smaller batches.

observations.description: In 7.6.1 and 7.6.2, if a local-in policy, local-in-policy6, DoS policy, interface policy, multicast policy, TTL policy, or central SNAT map is used in an interface in version 7.4.5, 7.6.0, or any previous GA version that was part of the SD-WAN zone, these policies will be deleted or show empty values after upgrading to version 7.6.1 or 7.6.2.
observations.workaround: After upgrading to 7.6.1 or 7.6.2, users must manually recreate these policies and assign them to the appropriate SD-WAN zone.

observations.description: Password encryption changes occur when editing config vpn certificate local without actual certificate changes.

When performing LDAP user searches from the GUI against LDAP servers with a large number of users (more than 100000), FortiGate may experience a performance issue and not operate as expected due to the HTTPSD process consuming too much memory. User may need to stop the HTTPSD process or perform a reboot to recover.
observations.workaround: Perform an LDAP user search using the CLI.

observations.description: AWS bootstrap is unable to parse IAM role profile properly due to the length.
The device encounters an issue where options in the ftgd-wf section cannot be unset when configuring a web filter via an Ansible playbook

In an HA environment with FortiAPs managed by primary FortiGate, the secondary FortiGate GUI Managed FortiAP page may show the FortiAP status as offline if the FortiAP traffic is not routed through the secondary FortiGate. This is only a GUI issue and does not impact FortiAP operation.
